overall: MARGINAL-to-POOR overall: five grounds are GOOD (Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Panlaitan), the east side and Alava are VERY POOR, and the Culion side is POOR
limiterDetail: The main limiter is east wind: Nangalao 21–26 kt, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 17–25 kt, Barangonan 16–23 kt, Ciron 13–24 kt, and Linapacan 12–19 kt over the next 24h. Second limiter is current: 0.9–1.7 kt now at Culion, Linapacan, Decabaitot, Alava, Binudac and Barangonan, rising to 1.5–2.4 kt about 11 PM–5 AM tonight. Rain is light, up to 1.5 mm/h at Barangonan about 9–11 PM.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning matching Calamian / MIMAROPA in the recent feed (a distant tropical cyclone alert is listed). See the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the morning digest (Tue 6:20 AM)
items: The fishing mix is about the same, with a small shift: Alava dropped to VERY POOR while Ciron and Barangonan improved to POOR. The supply outlook is unchanged. Fishing right now is 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 4 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 5 VERY POOR). Alava is VERY POOR because its current is 1.5 kt. Ciron (19.5 kt) and Barangonan (19.1 kt, current 1.4) eased a little as the east wind softened by 1–2 kt.

Regional wind: Wed 11 and Thu 12 are 14 kt, gusts 21 (was 15, g22), Fri 13 is 13 kt, gusts 19 (was 12, g18), Sat 14 6.5 kt, Sun 15 9.2 kt, Mon 16 12 kt, gusts 18. So Thu 12 and Fri 13 stay SOFT. The strong current pulse (1.5–2.4 kt) is unchanged at about 11 PM–5 AM tonight at Decabaitot, Alava, Barangonan, Culion and Binudac. PAGASA: no warning for Palawan. Shortage detector ELEVATED Tue–Mon; surge OFF.
